In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] used minuscule '''red spheres''' in their [[Battle of Tynna|invasion]] of [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. After the spheres were released from compartments in the base of a Yuuzhan Vong [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]], they rushed into the lagoon turning it a sickly pale yellow.<ref name="Jedi Eclipse" />
